releases.notes:
0.2.0:
- Revamped signal type system
- Echo lotus (terminates a signal going into it and creates a signal pulse behind it)
- Echo modulator (changes the frequency of the signal interacting with it, based on the power it receives)
- Echo Booster (refreshes a signal, this generally means setting the power to 16)
- Some new sfx
- New particles
- New mod icon

TODO:
- Add unique sounds for more blocks
- Fix loot table and recipe data

Future ideas:
- Battery block entity (stores a signal as nbt and releases it when powered)
- Bone chimes (plays different notes based on the signal frequency)
- Portals (allow signals to hop between dimensions like actual entities)
- Junction / splitter (duplicates the signal at a different position / direction)
- More control over signal power (maybe some sort of smart booster?)
- More signal types, might make the mod feel bloated I suppose, but the system I made has a lot of potential.

mods.name: Echoes
mods.description: A minecraft mod that adds a unique signal system, useful for making new kinds of redstone builds.

releases.notes:
- Added a new block that blocks signals going into it and creates a new "Pulse Signal" that only lasts 1 tick. This can be used as an alternative to echo blockers to fit things together more compactly.
- Signals use a flag to tell their manager to remove them at the end of the manager loop instead of being stored in a seperate list.
- Also includes changes to saving and loading that were not yet included in a build. The main change is that signals use smaller sized data types for their properties, and the nbt data for the signals includes a signal type list, which allows the signals to simply store an index to define their type (done per dimension).

mods.name: Echoes
mods.description: A minecraft mod that adds a unique signal system, useful for making new kinds of redstone builds.

releases.notes:
A relatively quick implementation of a system to allow for different types of signals.
This experimental build makes the corrupted echo rod produce corrupted signals that travel two blocks per step, but take two ticks per step (so they skip over blocks and travel twice as far).

I've hastily put this together, and a system like this will require much more work for me to be happy implementing into the full version of the mod. It is also not really a necessary inclusion, but if I get it working well, it could open up the doors for interesting mechanics.

I'll also add that if I were to make this system more robust, I might add a signal that only lasts 1 tick for stuff like junctions that send signals with a power of 1 to adjacent blocks. Tho this could be achieved using the existing signal with a power of 1, it would allow me to make the effect of the signal "death" different and fit within that scenario much better. Idk, we'll see!
